findings.title: Completeness promotion bypasses G1 start-to-completion proof
findings.description: Generic isUpsertMutationPromotion is evaluated before isHistoryObservationUpdate; partial-to-canonical turn updates can replace content_hash while retaining source_ref and skip durable start/order/coverage proof. A schema-valid same-position completion with recomputed FNV is accepted and marks temporary MemoryAnalysisStore canonical.
findings.qualification: Inbound validation counterexample, not observed host output or actual SQLite publication
findings.repair_scope: Importer and existing boundary tests; preserve G2 and strict other mutations; no new shared contract or unrelated product changes

provenance.assessment: Exact S4 code/diff/call chain/shared contract and saved final evidence reviewed;63 fixed/live attachment checks,9 subjects and8 protected hashes match;actual current Rust batch plus original old prefix used for isolated read-only importer counterexample;no product edits or full test rerun.
